column1: # Copy to servers.tsv (or let "tools/serverconfig.py add <id>" write it): <id><TAB><text in the server name><TAB><mod><TAB><addresses>
# A server whose name contains the text (colors ignored, any case) and whose mod is the row's (empty: any mod) gets
# serverconfigs/<id>.cfg and the voice chat of serverconfigs/vsays/<id>/. The first matching row wins, so list a single
# server before the tag of its clan. A clan with servers of two mods: one id per mod, <clan>_<mod>.
# Addresses (ip:port, comma-separated): the servers the row matched, added by tools/serverconfig.py, not used to match.
